hub.tldr: In short: Cochin Wood Industries is an Indian plywood exporter. We ship packing-grade, film-faced shuttering, Okoume-faced and marine plywood, plus boxes, crates and pallets, from Cochin to six GCC countries, Sri Lanka and Israel. USD quotes, FOB Cochin, 50% advance with balance before dispatch, by bank transfer (T/T). Quote replies within one business day.
faq: Does plywood need ISPM-15 treatment for export?

No. Plywood is a processed wood material and is exempt from ISPM-15, so the panels ship without a stamp or fumigation. The standard applies to solid-wood packaging such as timber runners in boxes, crates and pallets — and our packaging process is ISPM-15 compliant, so those components ship with treatment handled.
What are your export payment terms?
50% advance with the balance before dispatch for standard products; custom specifications are 100% advance. We accept bank transfer (T/T). Export quotes are in USD, FOB Cochin by default.
How many plywood sheets fit in a 20ft or 40ft container?

It depends on weight, not volume. Plywood reaches a container's permitted payload before the space fills, and destination road limits can lower the cap further, so the count varies with thickness, density and lane. Every quote includes a loading plan with sheets per container and net and gross weights.
How quickly can you send an export quote?
Within one business day. Send thickness and sheet size, grade or face veneer, quantity, and the destination port, and we reply with USD FOB pricing and a container loading plan.

hub.cta_p: Thickness, size, grade, quantity, destination port — that is all we need to return a USD FOB quote with a loading plan.

FOB Cochin is our default for export. CIF Jebel Ali is available on request, priced against current freight. All export quotes are issued in USD, and we reply to enquiries within one business day.
Does plywood need ISPM-15 treatment to enter the UAE?
Plywood panels are processed wood and exempt from ISPM-15. Where you buy assembled boxes, crates or pallets, ours are made under an ISPM-15 compliant process.
What are your payment terms for UAE buyers?
Standard products ship on 50 percent advance with the balance before dispatch. Custom specifications are 100 percent advance. We accept bank transfer (T/T).
What HS code is plywood under for the UAE imports?

The GCC Common External Tariff is 5% customs duty on the CIF value. 5% VAT is charged at import on the CIF value. We quote FCA or FOB Cochin in USD; duty and VAT are added by your agent at clearance.
What standards or conformity approval does the UAE require?

Clearance references ESMA / ECAS where the product is regulated; GSO standards otherwise. We supply the certificate of origin and product documentation your agent needs; regulated-product certificates are arranged where they apply.
What documents do you provide for the UAE customs?

Do you have a plywood factory or warehouse in UAE?

hero.lede: Colombo is the shortest export lane we run. Import plywood from India to Sri Lanka on a 2-4 day sail out of Cochin Port, quoted in USD, FOB Cochin or CIF Colombo.

countries.tldr: TL;DR: We are a plywood exporter serving Colombo and the rest of Sri Lanka from Kochi. Packing-grade, commercial and marine plywood, plus ready-made plywood boxes and crates. Port-to-port transit is 2-4 days. Quotes in USD, FOB Cochin or CIF Colombo. Ask us about ISFTA eligibility for your HS code. Every enquiry gets a written reply within one business day.
faq: How long does shipping take from Kochi to Colombo?
Port-to-port transit is typically 2-4 days, which makes Kochi to Colombo one of the shortest export lanes out of India. Add your local clearance and haulage time to plan door-to-door delivery.
Do you quote FOB Cochin or CIF Colombo?
Both. FOB Cochin is the default; if you prefer a single landed figure, we quote CIF Colombo with sea freight included. All export quotes are in USD.
Will my plywood shipment qualify for ISFTA duty concessions?

It depends on the HS code, Sri Lanka's tariff schedule and rules-of-origin conditions, so we do not guarantee a duty outcome. We confirm the HS code we ship under and provide the certificate of origin; your clearing agent confirms eligibility on the Sri Lankan side.
Does plywood from India need ISPM-15 treatment for Sri Lanka?

Plywood panels are processed wood and exempt from ISPM-15, so no heat-treatment marking is required on the panels themselves. Plywood boxes and crates we supply are built under an ISPM-15 compliant process.
Do you have a plywood factory or warehouse in Sri Lanka?

No — Cochin Wood is an Indian plywood factory near Cochin (Kochi), Kerala. We do not hold local stock or a warehouse in Sri Lanka; we ship full-container loads FOB Cochin to Colombo. You buy factory-direct from India.
countries.cta_h2: Get a Sri Lanka quote within one business day
countries.cta_p: Send us the grade, thickness, quantity and whether you want FOB Cochin or CIF Colombo. You will have a written USD quote within one business day. Email sales@cochinwood.in or WhatsApp +91 95674 10175.

countries.tldr: TL;DR For plywood importers in Israel: we quote FOB Cochin only, in USD, never CIF. You arrange ocean freight to Ashdod or Haifa; we manufacture, calibrate, pack and clear the goods onto your nominated vessel. Samples are available (chargeable). Quote replies within one business day.
faq: Do you quote CIF Ashdod or CIF Haifa?
No. All quotes for Israel are FOB Cochin, in USD. You or your forwarder arrange ocean freight and insurance; we deliver export-cleared goods on board your nominated vessel at Cochin Port.
Does the plywood need ISPM-15 treatment or fumigation?

No. Plywood is engineered wood and is exempt from ISPM-15, so the panels need no heat-treatment stamp or fumigation certificate. Any solid-wood pallets or crating in the shipment follow an ISPM-15-compliant process.
Can I get samples before placing an order?
Yes. Samples are available and chargeable. Most buyers check the Okoume face, thickness calibration and core before committing to a trial container.
What are the payment terms for Israeli buyers?
50% advance with the balance before dispatch for standard products, and 100% advance for custom production. We accept bank transfer (T/T).
Do you have a plywood factory or warehouse in Israel?

No — Cochin Wood is an Indian plywood factory near Cochin (Kochi), Kerala. We do not hold local stock or a warehouse in Israel; we ship full-container loads FOB Cochin to Ashdod or Haifa. You buy factory-direct from India.
